description: Platform default message templates, seeded into message_templates with garage_id null. Garages can override body/subject. Variables use {{double_braces}}. SMS bodies must stay under 160 characters after rendering where possible (max 2 segments). WhatsApp templates must be submitted to Meta for approval with the given name and category; variables map to {{1}}, {{2}}… in the order listed in 'whatsapp_params'. Emails render with React Email using the subject and body as content.

variables.vehicle: Make and model, e.g. Toyota Corolla
variables.action_link: Short magic link for the primary action
variables.items_list: Comma-separated due items for combined messages
variables.offer_line: Optional garage offer, starts with a space
variables.stop_link: One-tap opt-out URL for seasonal tips

inbound_whatsapp_sms.mileage_reply: If an inbound message from a known customer phone is a number between 1 and 2,000,000 (allowing commas and 'km'), and that customer has a mileage_confirm or mileage_nudge sent in the last 14 days, record it as an odometer reading (source customer_update) for that vehicle and reply 'Thanks! Updated {{plate}} to {{km}} km ✅'. If the customer has several vehicles, reply with a numbered list to choose.
inbound_whatsapp_sms.stop: STOP / UNSUBSCRIBE turns off that channel for marketing and reminders (not transactional) and replies with a confirmation.
inbound_whatsapp_sms.other: Forward to the garage inbox as a notification for the service advisor.
